parrafo_1.es: Oasis Pest Control, LLC es una empresa de control de plagas con licencia y seguro que atiende casas y negocios en West Palm Beach. Hacemos control general de plagas, roedores, mosquitos y tratamientos de césped y jardín, en inglés y español.
parrafo_1.en: Oasis Pest Control, LLC is a licensed and insured pest control company serving homes and businesses in West Palm Beach. We handle general pest control, rodents, mosquitoes and lawn & yard treatments, in English and Spanish.

parrafo_2.es: No proponemos nada sin antes inspeccionar la propiedad. Nuestros clientes nos calificaron con 5.0 en Google a lo largo de 32 reseñas reales: eso es lo que nos importa mantener.
parrafo_2.en: We do not propose anything without inspecting the property first. Our customers rated us 5.0 on Google across 32 real reviews, and that is what we work to keep.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué plaga tienes y en qué parte de la propiedad. Respondemos por teléfono, sin formularios ni intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell us what pest you are dealing with and where on the property. We answer by phone, no forms, no middlemen.

texto.es: Revisamos la propiedad para identificar la plaga y el punto de entrada antes de proponer nada.
texto.en: We walk the property to identify the pest and the entry point before proposing anything.

texto.es: Te explicamos el plan y el costo según lo que encontramos. Cada tratamiento se cotiza, no hay precios genéricos.
texto.en: We walk you through the plan and the cost based on what we found. Every treatment is quoted, no generic pricing.

texto.es: Aplicamos el tratamiento y hacemos seguimiento hasta resolver el problema.
texto.en: We apply the treatment and follow up until the problem is resolved.

nota.es: Cada tratamiento se cotiza según la propiedad y la plaga. Escríbenos y te damos el presupuesto.
nota.en: Every treatment is quoted based on the property and the pest. Message us and we will give you a quote.

texto.es: Hormigas, cucarachas, arañas y otras plagas comunes dentro y fuera de tu casa o negocio.
texto.en: Ants, cockroaches, spiders and other common pests inside and outside your home or business.

texto.es: Identificamos puntos de entrada y tratamos la presencia de ratas y roedores en la propiedad.
texto.en: We identify entry points and treat rat and rodent activity on the property.

texto.es: Tratamientos para reducir mosquitos en patios y áreas exteriores.
texto.en: Treatments to cut down mosquitoes in yards and outdoor areas.

texto.es: Fumigación de césped, control de mosca blanca en plantas ornamentales, control de malezas y programas de fertilización.
texto.en: Lawn spraying, whitefly treatment on ornamental plants, weed control and fertilization programs.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu problema aquí? Llámanos igual, atendemos casos distintos todos los días.
pie.en: Do not see your problem listed? Call us anyway, we handle all kinds of cases every day.

items.quote: I use oasis for both work and home, they are absolutely amazing and Ryan is so thorough and can take care of any needs. The whole staff is kind, friendly, professional and knowledgeable. They are the best!
The only reason Oasis Pest Control is getting 5 stars from me, is that it's the maximum option... they'd get 100 if I could!

Very happy with the services from Oasis Pest Control. Maria was helpful on the phone and Ryan did a great job inspecting and servicing our home. He answered all my questions and fixed our roach problem after only a few visits. One of the best companies I've dealt with in a while.
